# IFleetProxy
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IFleetProxy.sol)

**Inherits:**
ICrossChainReceiver

**Title:**
IFleetProxy

**Author:**
SummerFi

Interface for the FleetProxy contract that receives and holds assets on a satellite chain

Inherits ICrossChainReceiver to handle cross-chain messages


## Functions
### getBalance

Get the current balance of a token held by this proxy


```solidity
function getBalance(address token) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|Address of the token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Balance of the specified token|


### totalAssets

Get the total assets held by this proxy


```solidity
function totalAssets() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The total balance of the main asset|


### pause

Pause the contract functionality

Can only be called by authorized administrators


```solidity
function pause() external;
```

### unpause

Unpause the contract functionality

Can only be called by authorized administrators


```solidity
function unpause() external;
```

## Events
### AssetsSent
Emitted when assets are sent back to the source chain


```solidity
event AssetsSent(address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint16 indexed sourceChainId, bytes32 indexed messageId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|Address of the token sent|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens sent|
|`sourceChainId`|`uint16`|ID of the destination (source) chain|
|`messageId`|`bytes32`|Unique ID of the transfer message|

### ProxyDeposit
Emitted when assets are deposited into the proxy


```solidity
event ProxyDeposit(
    address indexed fleetContract, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint16 indexed sourceChainId
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetContract`|`address`|Address of the fleet contract|
|`token`|`address`|Address of the token deposited|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens deposited|
|`sourceChainId`|`uint16`|Source chain ID|

### ProxyWithdrawal
Emitted when assets are withdrawn from the proxy


```solidity
event ProxyWithdrawal(
    address indexed recipient, address indexed token, uint256 amount, bytes32 indexed operationId
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`recipient`|`address`|Address of the recipient|
|`token`|`address`|Address of the token withdrawn|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens withdrawn|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Unique ID of the operation|

### MessageContentNotExpected
Emitted when a message is not expected


```solidity
event MessageContentNotExpected();
```

### AssetsWithdrawnAndTransferred
Emitted when assets are withdrawn and transferred back to source chain


```solidity
event AssetsWithdrawnAndTransferred(uint256 amount, address asset, uint16 sourceChainId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens withdrawn|
|`asset`|`address`|Address of the token withdrawn|
|`sourceChainId`|`uint16`|Source chain ID|

## Errors
### InsufficientBalance
Thrown when trying to send tokens that exceed available balance


```solidity
error InsufficientBalance(uint256 requested, uint256 available);
```

### BridgeOperationFailed
Thrown when the bridge operation fails


```solidity
error BridgeOperationFailed();
```

### CallerNotRegisteredAdapter
Thrown when the caller is not a registered adapter


```solidity
error CallerNotRegisteredAdapter();
```

### NoMessage
Thrown when a function is not meant to be called directly


```solidity
error NoMessage();
```

### NoAssets
Thrown when no assets are deposited


```solidity
error NoAssets();
```

### InvalidOperation
Thrown when an invalid operation is attempted


```solidity
error InvalidOperation();
```

### InvalidAsset
Thrown when an invalid asset is attempted to be deposited


```solidity
error InvalidAsset();
```

### InvalidSourceChain
Error thrown when source chain is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidSourceChain();
```

### InvalidFleetContract
Error thrown when fleet contract address is invalid


### WithdrawalFailed
Error thrown when withdrawal failed


```solidity
error WithdrawalFailed();
```

### InvalidAmount
Error thrown when the amount is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidAmount();
```

### InvalidRecipient
Error thrown when the recipient is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidRecipient();
```

### InvalidRequestor
Error thrown when the requestor is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidRequestor();
```

### InvalidSatelliteChain

### InvalidBridgeRouter

### InvalidRegistry
